# Section 040 Knowledge Check: Audit Trails And Compliance Evidence

<!-- TODO(build): generated by /astrona-course-generate-assessment against the objectives below. Scenario questions, no recall trivia. -->

## Coverage

- Write an audit policy that records Secret access at Metadata level, Deployment changes at RequestResponse and drops noisy read events
- Turn on audit logging by editing the kube-apiserver static pod manifest with the policy file, log path and volumes
- Confirm the API server restarted with the new flags and find the problem when it does not come back
- Find who deleted a Deployment, with which identity and when, in the audit log with jq
- Name the audit level and stage of a given event and say why a rule matched it
- Read a Kyverno PolicyReport and list which workloads fail which rule, with kubectl and with custom columns
- Read Gatekeeper audit results from a Constraint's status and name each violating object
- Pull the audit events for one compliance question (who changed a Deployment, who read a Secret) as evidence
- Choose which source answers a given auditor question (what breaks policy now, what changed, who did it)
- Explain why an Audit-mode policy and Gatekeeper audit report existing objects that admission never saw
